question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a teal ball, Bob has a red ball, and Claire has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) teal ball
(B) red ball
(C) gold ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (teal, red, gold)
1. Swap Alice and Bob: (red, teal, gold)
2. Swap Alice and Bob: (teal, red, gold)
3. Swap Claire and Alice: (gold, red, teal)
Bob has the red ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
